name: wolfpack
description: A way of working with Claude Code: a navigator that plans and hands work to named specialists, budgets per agent, design and QA crews, and a production guard for Supabase projects.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: The wolfpack's shared core: the scout, test-runner, debugger, seniors and researchers, the planning, wrap-up, research, docs and routine skills, and the norms and lessons every project follows.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Releases end to end: the navigator (maverick, captain-call), the builders, the review, the PR and deploy skills (carousel, its-a-trap, skinny-pete, one-ring, cattle-drive), the audits, and Hank, the hook that holds every agent to its token budget.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: The wolfpack's design crew: heisenberg's briefs and studio, mosbius-designs' mock-ups, the QA coach and the Bengan Boys, daredevil's accessibility review, darth-vader's full QA, the spidey-sense browser checks, the voice card and a taste template.

plugins.name: database
plugins.description: The Supabase pack: the production guard (the Slap Bet Commissioner) with its hooks, the deployer ranjit and the-playbook, and SQL tests with bro-code. The production database scripts stay in each project's own scripts/ folder.

plugins.name: wolfpack
plugins.description: The whole kit in one install: no components of its own, it depends on core, release, design and database, which Claude Code installs with it at the same scope.
